Verify a Raspberry Pi boot signature against a public key.

## Inputs

| Name         | Kind | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`      | file | FAT boot.img that the signature authenticates.                  |
| `signature`  | file | Raspberry Pi boot.sig returned by the signer.                   |
| `public-key` | file | PEM-encoded RSA-2048 public key that must verify the signature. |

## Outputs

| Name        | Kind | Description                               |
| ----------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `signature` | file | Verified Raspberry Pi RSA-2048 signature. |

## Execution

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Environment  | Rugix Bakery |
| Source epoch | Ignored      |
| Output cache | Allowed      |

## Behavior

Check a Raspberry Pi boot signature independently of the signer that created it.
The rule verifies `signature` over `image` with `public-key` using the pinned
upstream `rpi-eeprom-digest` tool and enforces the 180 MB RAM disk budget of
`boot.img`.

Compositions run this rule after every replaceable Raspberry Pi signer, such as
the `rpi-signer` rule parameter of
[`core/image-rpi-verified`](../image-rpi-verified/).

## Example

```toml
uses = "core/verify-rpi"
inputs.image = { path = "boot.img" }
inputs.signature = { path = "boot.sig" }
inputs.public-key = { path = "keys/boot.pub" }
```

Save the invocation as `build-rule.toml` and run
`./run-bakery bake rule build-rule.toml build/result`.
